analysis.reasonEn: RSI has entered oversold territory with MACD histogram showing improvement. ADX at 27.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, hinting at a potential recovery. Current price ($90.50) is -26.63% below SMA200 ($123.34), indicating weakness, but oversold exit signals are observed. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further confirmation.
